configurationDecision.reason: A legitimate official EGID API surface was discovered, but the exact GET historical request parameters, auth requirement, response OHLCV field names, raw integer-volume semantics, and finalized-EOD semantics are not proven by the accessible contract view. Guessing any of those would violate the G11 acceptance rules. No authorized secret write capability is available in the current GitHub connector.

ehdrReadOnlyValidation.reason: No exact, credential-safe, parser-compatible EGID GetSymbolHistories request could be constructed without guessing required parameters/auth/schema. Other providers did not meet the stronger exact-market-truth threshold.

exactNextAction: Obtain the exact EGID Feed API access contract for GET /api/DelayedFeed/GetSymbolHistories — required query parameters, authentication requirement/credential, response JSON schema, and confirmation that its daily historical row carries raw session Open/High/Low/Close plus exact integer traded-share Volume for a completed session — then configure EGX_HISTORY_API_URL manually only if that GET response maps to the existing adapter without code changes, and run EHDR/2026-09-17 read-only first.
